b644-me-engineering-drawing-practice.subarea: 2013 TOS Machine Design 2.27 Engineering Drawing Practices
b644-me-engineering-drawing-practice.description: Interpretation and communication of mechanical engineering drawings, orthographic and sectional views, projection, dimensioning, and drawing conventions. This is a BoardPrep-derived competency aligned to the explicitly named 2013 TOS subarea.
allowed: foundational drawing interpretation, views/projections, sections, and dimensioning taught in linked course material
excluded: current ISO/ASME drafting-standard conformity, manufacturing tolerances, and code-specific drawing requirements not covered by linked material
limits: PRC Resolution 57 (2013) names Engineering Drawing Practices at 2.27; no replacement detailed TOS was located. NPTEL material supports foundational practice only, not current standards compliance.
